I farm a rented bean plot, so I have to be careful with what I spend, but I still want a good harvest. I will use some improved seed if I can get it, rely more on family work, and add manure because it helps the soil and is cheaper than using a lot of chemical fertilizer. I will use a small amount of chemical fertilizer and some pesticide or herbicide if weeds or pests become a problem, but I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains.
